verdict.rationale: Runpod's docs say Pods support custom containers pulled from any compatible registry (Docker Hub, GHCR, ECR). The CLI takes an arbitrary `--image` at Pod creation, and templates are described as pre-configured Docker image setups you can manage via the CLI, GraphQL API and MCP server. A community user also reports deploying community templates in a few clicks. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on authoring a custom template (env vars, ports, disk), explicit private-registry credential setup steps, and independent hands-on corroboration of running a user's own image.
